pageTitle: Whimsical World - Words & Jars — Back to Roots

program.title: Whimsical World - Words & Jars
program.description: Create magical storytelling jars filled with words, colors, and tiny treasures that spark imagination. Develop language skills and creative expression while building personal story collections in beautiful, handcrafted memory jars.
program.imageAlt: Colorful story jars created by children

items.title: Jar Decoration Workshop
items.description: Transform simple glass jars into magical containers using natural materials, ribbons, and colorful decorations.

items.title: Story Words Collection
items.description: Write inspiring words, draw tiny pictures, and create miniature story elements that will live inside your magical jar.

items.title: Memory Making Magic
items.description: Add special treasures like dried flowers, colorful stones, and meaningful objects that represent personal stories and dreams.

items.title: Story Sharing Circle
items.description: Share the stories behind your jars, practice storytelling skills, and listen to wonderful tales from other young creators.

items.label: What to bring
items.value: Creative imagination, water bottle, small personal treasures (optional)

items.label: Take home
items.value: Decorated story jar, collection of word cards, storytelling guide
